correctness.rationale: The assembled tensor-product stiffness and positive diagonal quadrature mass reproduce the stated method. The exact parity-block inversion re-derives all 55 symmetry classes of its 625 Green entries. Exact sign-variation certificate proves each nonwitness rational function strictly positive until the root and the witness strictly negative afterward. Unique positive root follows from Descartes and rational sign bracket; exact rational negative witness at t=5 verified algebraically. No finite numerical sampling is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sharp cutoff answers the source literature’s explicit concern that its mesh-grading sufficiency condition may not be sharp, on the natural minimal nontrivial symmetric three-cell-per-axis square. It quantitatively identifies how much a graded Q2 grid can depart from quasi-uniformity before a nodal discrete maximum principle fails; the exact eighth-entry equality orbit gives a tight reproducibility benchmark. This is a motivated exact finite-dimensional classification rather than a routine prescribed-data computation; no wider theorem is claimed.
